basic_profile.bio: Hailing from the sunny coast of California, PokeSporeMaster87 is a long-time Redditor with a passion for mobile gaming and niche hobbies. With an extensive background in IT, they work as a software developer by day and an avid gamer by night. Often found posting late into the evening, they are a night owl who enjoys unwinding with a few rounds of Pokemon Go or tinkering with Spore mods. They are happily married with two green-cheeked conures that occasionally make appearances in their posts. Aside from gaming, they love hiking and exploring nature trails with their partner.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: PokeSporeMaster87 has a solid foundation in computer science, having earned a degree in Software Engineering from a reputable university. Over the years, they have self-taught various programming languages and game development techniques, contributing to modding communities and engaging in beta tests for new games. Their expertise extends to both technical and creative aspects of software and game development.
